sentences.en: The long war at Troy was over.
sentences.tgt: La:o longue:a guerre:n à:o Troie:o était:v finie:a .:o

sentences.en: The kings of Greece sailed home over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Les:o rois:n de:o Grèce:o rentrèrent:v chez:o eux:o par:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: But one king did not come home.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o un:o roi:n ne:o rentra:v pas:o chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: His name was Odysseus, and his home was Ithaca.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o appelait:v Odysseus:o ,:o et:o sa:o maison:n était:v Ithaca:o .:o

sentences.en: In Ithaca his wife Penelope waited for him.
sentences.tgt: À:o Ithaca:o ,:o sa:o femme:n Penelope:o l':o attendait:v .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: My king has been gone for many years.
sentences.tgt: «:o Penelope:o ::o Mon:o roi:n est:v parti:a depuis:o de:o nombreuses:a années:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Telemachus: Now I am a man, but my father is gone.
sentences.tgt: «:o Télémaque:o ::o Je:o suis:v maintenant:a un:o homme:n ,:o mais:o mon:o père:n est:v parti:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: Bad men came to the hall of Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: De:o mauvais:a hommes:n vinrent:v dans:o la:o salle:n d':o Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: Suitor: Odysseus is dead, Penelope.
sentences.tgt: «:o Prétendant:o ::o Odysseus:o est:v mort:a ,:o Penelope:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Suitor: Take one of us for your king today.
sentences.tgt: «:o Prétendant:o ::o Prends:v l':o un:o de:o nous:o pour:o ton:o roi:n aujourd'hui:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: Penelope: I will not, while my king may live.
sentences.tgt: «:o Penelope:o ::o Je:o ne:o le:o ferai:v pas:o ,:o tant:o que:o mon:o roi:n peut:v vivre:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Suitor: Then we will eat your food and drink your wine.
sentences.tgt: «:o Prétendant:o ::o Alors:o nous:o mangerons:v ta:o nourriture:n et:o boirons:v ton:o vin:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The bad men ate the food and drank the wine every day.
sentences.tgt: Les:o mauvais:a hommes:n mangeaient:v la:o nourriture:n et:o buvaient:v le:o vin:n chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: Telemachus: I will sail out and look for the king.
sentences.tgt: Télémaque:o ::o Je:o vais:v naviguer:v et:o chercher:v le:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena, a goddess, came down to Telemachus.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ,:o une:o déesse:n ,:o descendit:v vers:o Télémaque:o .:o

sentences.en: Athena: Be brave, for your father is not dead.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o Sois:v courageux:a ,:o car:o ton:o père:n n':o est:v pas:o mort:a .:o

sentences.en: Athena: Odysseus wants to come home over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o Odysseus:o veut:v rentrer:v chez:o lui:o par:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus had left Troy with his men.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o avait:v quitté:v Troie:o avec:o ses:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Twelve ships sailed with him over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Douze:o navires:n naviguèrent:v avec:o lui:o sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: A storm blew the ships to a far land.
sentences.tgt: Une:o tempête:n poussa:v les:o navires:n vers:o une:o terre:n lointaine:a .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Go and see what men live here.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Allez:v voir:v quels:o hommes:n vivent:v ici:a .:o

sentences.en: Three men walked in and met a kind people.
sentences.tgt: Trois:o hommes:n entrèrent:v et:o rencontrèrent:v un:o peuple:n aimable:a .:o

sentences.en: These people ate only the fruit of the lotus.
sentences.tgt: Ces:o gens:n mangeaient:v seulement:a le:o fruit:n du:o lotus:n .:o

sentences.en: Lotus Man: Eat this sweet fruit and stay with us.
sentences.tgt: Lotus:o Man:o ::o «:o Mange:v ce:o fruit:n doux:a et:o reste:v avec:o nous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: The three men ate the lotus and forgot their home.
sentences.tgt: Les:o trois:o hommes:n mangèrent:v le:o lotus:n et:o oublièrent:v leur:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Why do my men not come back?
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Pourquoi:o mes:o hommes:n ne:o reviennent:v -ils:o pas:o ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus walked in and found them with the lotus.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o entra:v et:o les:o trouva:v avec:o le:o lotus:n .:o

sentences.en: Lost Man: I will not go from here.
sentences.tgt: Homme:n perdu:a ::o «:o Je:o ne:o partirai:v pas:o d':o ici:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: This sweet fruit made you forget your home.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Ce:o fruit:n doux:a vous:o a:v fait:v oublier:v votre:o maison:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: You forget your wife over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Tu:o oublies:v ta:o femme:n au-delà:o de:o la:o mer:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus pulled the three men back to the ship.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ramena:v les:o trois:o hommes:n au:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Row hard, men, and leave this land.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Ramez:v fort:a ,:o hommes:n ,:o et:o quittez:v cette:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The ships sailed on over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Les:o navires:n voguèrent:v sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Next the ships came to an island.
sentences.tgt: Ensuite:a les:o navires:n arrivèrent:v à:o une:o île:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: A great cave is up on the land.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Une:o grande:a grotte:n se:o trouve:v sur:o la:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Take some men and some wine.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Prenez:v quelques:o hommes:n et:o du:o vin:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus went up to the cave with his men.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o monta:v à:o la:o grotte:n avec:o ses:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: In the cave they found food to eat.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o grotte:n ils:o trouvèrent:v de:o la:o nourriture:n à:o manger:v .:o

sentences.en: Man: Take this food and go to the ship.
sentences.tgt: Homme:n ::o «:o Prenez:v cette:o nourriture:n et:o allez:v au:o navire:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: No, I want to see the one who lives here.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Non:o ,:o je:o veux:v voir:v celui:o qui:o vit:v ici:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: The cave was the home of a giant.
sentences.tgt: La:o grotte:n était:v le:o foyer:n d':o un:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: Men called the giant a Cyclops.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n appelaient:v le:o géant:n un:o Cyclope:o .:o

sentences.en: The Cyclops had one eye and ate men.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Cyclope:o avait:v un:o œil:n et:o mangeait:v des:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: He came home with his sheep.
sentences.tgt: Il:o rentra:v chez:o lui:o avec:o ses:o moutons:n .:o

sentences.en: He put a great stone over the cave.
sentences.tgt: Il:o plaça:v une:o grande:a pierre:n sur:o la:o grotte:n .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Who are you, and why are you here?
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o Qui:o êtes:v -vous:o ,:o et:o pourquoi:o êtes:v -vous:o ici:a ?:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: We are men of Greece, on our way home.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Nous:o sommes:v des:o hommes:n de:o Grèce:o ,:o en:o chemin:n vers:o notre:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Be kind to us, as the gods say.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Soyez:v bons:a envers:o nous:o ,:o comme:o les:o dieux:n le:o disent:v .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: I want nothing from you and your gods.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o Je:o ne:o veux:v rien:o de:o vous:o et:o de:o vos:o dieux:n .:o

sentences.en: The Cyclops took two men and ate them.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Cyclope:o prit:v deux:o hommes:n et:o les:o mangea:v .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Sleep now, and I will eat more men.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o Dormez:v maintenant:a ,:o et:o je:o mangerai:v d':o autres:a hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: The Cyclops ate two more of the men.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Cyclope:o mangea:v deux:o autres:a des:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: He took his sheep out of the cave.
sentences.tgt: Il:o fit:v sortir:v ses:o moutons:n de:o la:o grotte:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: We cannot move that great stone.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Nous:o ne:o pouvons:v pas:o déplacer:v cette:o grande:a pierre:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: But I will hurt this giant and get away.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Mais:o je:o vais:v blesser:v ce:o géant:n et:o m':o échapper:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus and his men made a great pole with a sharp end.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o et:o ses:o hommes:n fabriquèrent:v un:o grand:a pieu:n avec:o une:o extrémité:n pointue:a .:o

sentences.en: At night the Cyclops came to the cave.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n le:o Cyclope:n vint:v à:o la:o grotte:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: But I will give him wine to drink.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Mais:o je:o vais:v lui:o donner:v du:o vin:n à:o boire:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Here, take this wine and drink.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Tiens:v ,:o prends:v ce:o vin:n et:o bois:v .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Give me more of this wine.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o Donne:v -moi:o encore:a de:o ce:o vin:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Here is more wine, great Cyclops.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Voici:o encore:a du:o vin:n ,:o grand:a Cyclope:o .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Tell me your name, man.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o Dis:v -moi:o ton:o nom:n ,:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: My name is Nobody.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Mon:o nom:n est:v Personne:o .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Then Nobody is the last man I will eat.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o Alors:o Personne:o est:v le:o dernier:a homme:n que:o je:o vais:v manger:v .:o

sentences.en: The giant drank more wine and fell to sleep.
sentences.tgt: Le:o géant:n but:v plus:a de:o vin:n et:o tomba:v en:o sommeil:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus and his men made the pole hot in the cave.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o et:o ses:o hommes:n chauffèrent:v le:o pieu:n dans:o la:o grotte:n .:o

sentences.en: They put the sharp end into his one eye.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o mirent:v l':o extrémité:n pointue:a dans:o son:o unique:a œil:n .:o

sentences.en: The Cyclops woke and called out.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Cyclope:o se:o réveilla:v et:o cria:v .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Nobody has put out my eye!
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o «:o Personne:o n':o a:v mis:v mon:o œil:n hors:o de:o combat:n !:o »:o

sentences.en: Giant: If nobody hurt you, why call us here?
sentences.tgt: Géant:o ::o «:o Si:o personne:o ne:o t':o a:v blessé:a ,:o pourquoi:o nous:o appeler:v ici:a ?:o »:o

sentences.en: The other giants went away and gave no help.
sentences.tgt: Les:o autres:a géants:n partirent:v et:o n':o apportèrent:v aucune:o aide:n .:o

sentences.en: The Cyclops could not see, and sat in the cave door.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Cyclope:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o voir:v ,:o et:o s':o assit:v à:o l':o entrée:n de:o la:o grotte:n .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: No man will get out now.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ::o «:o Aucun:o homme:n ne:o sortira:v maintenant:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus looked at the sheep in the cave.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o regarda:v les:o moutons:n dans:o la:o grotte:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: We will go out under the sheep.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Nous:o sortirons:v sous:o les:o moutons:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: He tied his men under the sheep.
sentences.tgt: Il:o attacha:v ses:o hommes:n sous:o les:o moutons:n .:o

sentences.en: At day the sheep walked out to eat.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jour:n les:o moutons:n sortirent:v pour:o manger:v .:o

sentences.en: The Cyclops put his hand on each sheep, not the men.
sentences.tgt: Le:o Cyclope:o posa:v sa:o main:n sur:o chaque:o mouton:n ,:o pas:o sur:o les:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: One by one the men came out.
sentences.tgt: Un:o par:o un:o les:o hommes:n sortirent:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Run to the ship with the sheep.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ,:o courez:v au:o navire:n avec:o les:o moutons:n .:o

sentences.en: They rowed out to sea with the sheep.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o ramèrent:v vers:o la:o mer:n avec:o les:o moutons:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: You ate my men, Cyclops!
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ,:o tu:o as:v mangé:v mes:o hommes:n ,:o Cyclope:o !:o

sentences.en: The giant threw a great rock at the sea.
sentences.tgt: Le:o géant:n lança:v un:o grand:a rocher:n vers:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Tell me the name of the man who did this.
sentences.tgt: Cyclope:o ,:o dis:v -moi:o le:o nom:n de:o l':o homme:n qui:o fit:v cela:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Odysseus of Ithaca put out your eye.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ,:o Odysseus:o d':o Ithaca:o t':o a:v crevé:v l':o œil:n .:o

sentences.en: Cyclops: Poseidon, keep this man from his home.
sentences.tgt: Poseidon:o ,:o empêche:v cet:o homme:n de:o rentrer:v chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Poseidon, the god of the sea, heard him.
sentences.tgt: Poseidon:o ,:o le:o dieu:n de:o la:o mer:n ,:o l':o entendit:v .:o

sentences.en: From that day the sea god kept Odysseus from home.
sentences.tgt: À:o partir:v de:o ce:o jour:n ,:o le:o dieu:n de:o la:o mer:n empêcha:v Odysseus:o de:o rentrer:v chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: The ships came to the island of Aeolus.
sentences.tgt: Les:o navires:n arrivèrent:v à:o l':o île:n d':o Éole:o .:o

sentences.en: Aeolus was the god of the winds.
sentences.tgt: Éole:o était:v le:o dieu:n des:o vents:n .:o

sentences.en: Aeolus: I will help you get home, king.
sentences.tgt: Éole:o ::o «:o Je:o vais:v vous:o aider:v à:o rentrer:v chez:o vous:o ,:o roi:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: He put all the winds into a great bag.
sentences.tgt: Il:o mit:v tous:o les:o vents:n dans:o un:o grand:a sac:n .:o

sentences.en: Aeolus: Do not open this bag, and one wind will take you home.
sentences.tgt: Éole:o ::o «:o N':o ouvrez:v pas:o ce:o sac:n ,:o et:o un:o vent:n vous:o ramènera:v chez:o vous:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: For nine days the ship went home over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o neuf:o jours:n le:o navire:n rentra:v chez:o lui:o sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus held the bag and did not sleep.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o tenait:v le:o sac:n et:o ne:o dormit:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: On the last day they came near home.
sentences.tgt: Le:o dernier:a jour:n ils:o arrivèrent:v près:o de:o chez:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: Then Odysseus fell to sleep.
sentences.tgt: Alors:o Odysseus:o s':o endormit:v .:o

sentences.en: Man: What is in that great bag?
sentences.tgt: L':o homme:n ::o «:o Qu':o est:v -ce:o qu':o il:o y:o a:v dans:o ce:o grand:a sac:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Man: There is gold from Troy in it.
sentences.tgt: L':o homme:n ::o «:o Il:o y:o a:v de:o l':o or:n de:o Troie:o là-dedans:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Man: Let us open it and take the gold.
sentences.tgt: L':o homme:n ::o «:o Ouvrons:v -la:o et:o prenons:v l':o or:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The men opened the great bag.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n ouvrirent:v le:o grand:a sac:n .:o

sentences.en: All the winds came out.
sentences.tgt: Tous:o les:o vents:n sortirent:v .:o

sentences.en: A wind blew the ship away from home.
sentences.tgt: Un:o vent:n poussa:v le:o navire:n loin:a de:o chez:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus woke and saw home go away.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o se:o réveilla:v et:o vit:v sa:o maison:n s':o éloigner:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: My own men have done this to us.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Mes:o propres:a hommes:n nous:o ont:v fait:v cela:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: The wind blew them back to Aeolus.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vent:n les:o ramena:v vers:o Éole:o .:o

sentences.en: Aeolus: The gods are not with you, so go.
sentences.tgt: Éole:o ::o «:o Les:o dieux:n ne:o sont:v pas:o avec:o vous:o ,:o alors:o partez:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Next the ships came to the island of Circe.
sentences.tgt: Ensuite:a les:o navires:n arrivèrent:v à:o l':o île:n de:o Circe:o .:o

sentences.en: Circe had magic and lived in a house of stone.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o avait:v de:o la:o magie:n et:o vivait:v dans:o une:o maison:n de:o pierre:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Go and see this land.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Allez:v voir:v cette:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: His men came to the house of Circe.
sentences.tgt: Ses:o hommes:n vinrent:v à:o la:o maison:n de:o Circe:o .:o

sentences.en: Circe: Come in, men, and eat with me.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o «:o Entrez:v ,:o hommes:n ,:o et:o mangez:v avec:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: She gave them food with magic in it.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o leur:o donna:v de:o la:o nourriture:n avec:o de:o la:o magie:n dedans:o .:o

sentences.en: Circe put out her hand, and the men became pigs.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o tendit:v la:o main:n ,:o et:o les:o hommes:n devinrent:v des:o cochons:n .:o

sentences.en: Circe: Now you are pigs, and here you will stay.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o «:o Maintenant:a vous:o êtes:v des:o cochons:n ,:o et:o ici:a vous:o resterez:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: One man ran back to tell Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: Un:o homme:n courut:v en-arrière:a pour:o dire:v à:o Odysseus:o ce:o qui:o s':o était:v passé:v .:o

sentences.en: Man: Circe has made our men into pigs.
sentences.tgt: Homme:o ::o «:o Circe:o a:v transformé:v nos:o hommes:n en:o cochons:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: I will go and get my men back.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Je:o vais:v aller:v chercher:v mes:o hommes:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The god Hermes came down to him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o dieu:n Hermes:o descendit:v vers:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Hermes: Eat this plant, and her magic cannot hurt you.
sentences.tgt: Hermes:o ::o «:o Mange:v cette:o plante:n ,:o et:o sa:o magie:n ne:o peut:v pas:o te:o blesser:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus ate the plant and came to the house.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o mangea:v la:o plante:n et:o vint:v à:o la:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Circe put out her hand, but he did not become a pig.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o tendit:v la:o main:n ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o devint:v pas:o cochon:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Make my men men again, Circe.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Rends:v mes:o hommes:n hommes:n à:o nouveau:a ,:o Circe:o .:o

sentences.en: Circe: You must be Odysseus, so I will free your men.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Tu:o dois:v être:v Odysseus:o ,:o donc:o je:o vais:v libérer:v tes:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: She gave the pigs her hand, and they became men.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o donna:v sa:o main:n aux:o cochons:n ,:o et:o ils:o devinrent:v des:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus and his men were with Circe for a year.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o et:o ses:o hommes:n restèrent:v avec:o Circe:o pendant:o un:o an:n .:o

sentences.en: When the year was over, the men wanted home.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o l':o année:n fut:v terminée:a ,:o les:o hommes:n voulaient:v rentrer:v chez:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Circe, how do we get home from here?
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Circe:o ,:o comment:o rentrons:v -nous:o chez:o nous:o depuis:o ici:a ?:o

sentences.en: Circe: You will pass the rocks of the Sirens.

sentences.en: Circe: Their song makes men die on the rocks.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Leur:o chant:n fait:v mourir:v les:o hommes:n sur:o les:o rochers:n .:o

sentences.en: Circe: Put soft wax in the ears of your men.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Mets:v de:o la:o cire:n douce:a dans:o les:o oreilles:n de:o tes:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Circe: If you want to hear, be tied to the mast.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Si:o tu:o veux:v entendre:v ,:o fais:v -toi:o attacher:v au:o mât:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus put wax in the ears of his men.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o mit:v de:o la:o cire:n dans:o les:o oreilles:n de:o ses:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Tie me to the mast and do not set me free.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Attachez:v -moi:o au:o mât:n et:o ne:o me:o libérez:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: The men tied him and rowed hard.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n le:o lièrent:v et:o ramèrent:v fort:a .:o

sentences.en: Then the song of the Sirens came over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Puis:o le:o chant:n des:o Sirènes:o vint:v sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Siren: Come to us, Odysseus, and hear our song.
sentences.tgt: Sirène:o ::o Viens:v vers:o nous:o ,:o Odysseus:o ,:o et:o écoute:v notre:o chant:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus wanted the song so much that he cried out.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o voulait:v tellement:a le:o chant:n qu':o il:o cria:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Set me free now!
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Libère:v -moi:o maintenant:a !:o

sentences.en: But his men rowed on and held Odysseus down.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o ses:o hommes:n continuèrent:v à:o ramer:v et:o maintinrent:v Odysseus:o en:o bas:a .:o

sentences.en: At last the ship passed the rocks.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a le:o navire:n dépassa:v les:o rochers:n .:o

sentences.en: The men took the wax out and set Odysseus free.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n retirèrent:v la:o cire:n et:o libérèrent:v Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: Circe had told them of Scylla and Charybdis.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o leur:o avait:v parlé:v de:o Scylla:o et:o de:o Charybdis:o .:o

sentences.en: Circe: Scylla lives in the high rocks.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Scylla:o vit:v dans:o les:o hauts:a rochers:n .:o

sentences.en: Circe: She has six heads, and each takes a man.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Elle:o a:v six:o têtes:n ,:o et:o chacune:o prend:v un:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Circe: Charybdis pulls the sea and ships down.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Charybdis:o tire:v la:o mer:n et:o les:o navires:n vers:o le:o bas:a .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: How can we live between the two?
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ,:o Comment:o pouvons:v -nous:o vivre:v entre:o les:o deux:o ?:o

sentences.en: Circe: Go near Scylla, and lose six men, not all.
sentences.tgt: Circe:o ::o Approchez:v -vous:o de:o Scylla:o ,:o et:o vous:o perdrez:v six:o hommes:n ,:o pas:o tous:o .:o

sentences.en: The ship came to the sea between them.
sentences.tgt: Le:o navire:n arriva:v à:o la:o mer:n entre:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Keep away from Charybdis, and row hard.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Restez:v loin:a de:o Charybdis:o ,:o et:o ramez:v fort:a .:o

sentences.en: He did not tell his men of Scylla in the rocks.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o dit:v pas:o à:o ses:o hommes:n ce:o qu':o il:o y:o avait:v de:o Scylla:o dans:o les:o rochers:n .:o

sentences.en: As they came near, Scylla put down her heads.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o ils:o s':o approchèrent:v ,:o Scylla:o abaissa:v ses:o têtes:n .:o

sentences.en: Her six heads took six men from the ship.
sentences.tgt: Ses:o six:o têtes:n prirent:v six:o hommes:n du:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: Man: Odysseus, help us!
sentences.tgt: Homme:n ::o Odysseus:o ,:o aide:v -nous:o !:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: I could do nothing for them.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Je:o ne:o pouvais:v rien:o faire:v pour:o eux:o .:o

sentences.en: It was a hard thing for Odysseus to see.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v une:o chose:n difficile:a à:o voir:v pour:o Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: But the ship came away, and the men still lived.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o navire:n s':o éloigna:v ,:o et:o les:o hommes:n vivaient:v encore:a .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Row on, for we are not all dead.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Ramez:v encore:a ,:o car:o nous:o ne:o sommes:v pas:o tous:o morts:a .:o

sentences.en: Next the ship came to the island of the Sun.
sentences.tgt: Ensuite:a le:o navire:n arriva:v à:o l':o île:n du:o Soleil:o .:o

sentences.en: On the land were the cattle of the sun god.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o la:o terre:n se:o trouvaient:v les:o bovins:n du:o dieu:n du:o soleil:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Circe told us not to touch these cattle.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Circe:o nous:o a:v dit:v de:o ne:o pas:o toucher:v ces:o bovins:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: If we do, we will not see home.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Si:o nous:o le:o faisons:v ,:o nous:o ne:o verrons:v pas:o notre:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Eat only the food we have on the ship.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Mangez:v seulement:a la:o nourriture:n que:o nous:o avons:v sur:o le:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: But a storm kept the ship on the land for days.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o une:o tempête:n retint:v le:o navire:n sur:o la:o terre:n pendant:o des:o jours:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon all the food on the ship was gone.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a toute:o la:o nourriture:n sur:o le:o navire:n fut:v épuisée:a .:o

sentences.en: The men looked at the cattle of the sun god.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n regardèrent:v les:o bovins:n du:o dieu:n du:o soleil:n .:o

sentences.en: Man: We will die here if we do not eat.
sentences.tgt: Homme:o ::o Nous:o mourrons:v ici:a si:o nous:o ne:o mangeons:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: While Odysseus slept, the men killed the cattle.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o qu':o Odysseus:o dormait:v ,:o les:o hommes:n tuèrent:v les:o bovins:n .:o

sentences.en: They made a fire and ate the cattle.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o firent:v un:o feu:n et:o mangèrent:v les:o bovins:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus woke and saw the fire.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o se:o réveilla:v et:o vit:v le:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: What have you done, men?
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Qu':o avez-vous:o fait:v ,:o hommes:n ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: The sun god will make us pay.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Le:o dieu:n du:o soleil:n nous:o fera:v payer:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: The sun god saw his cattle dead and called to Zeus.
sentences.tgt: Le:o dieu:n du:o soleil:n vit:v ses:o bovins:n morts:a et:o appela:v Zeus:o .:o

sentences.en: Sun God: Make these men pay for this.
sentences.tgt: Dieu:n du:o Soleil:n ::o «:o Fais:v payer:v ces:o hommes:n pour:o cela:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Zeus: I will break their ship in the sea.
sentences.tgt: Zeus:o ::o «:o Je:o briserai:v leur:o navire:n dans:o la:o mer:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: When the storm went, the ship sailed out.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o la:o tempête:n passa:v ,:o le:o navire:n prit:v la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Zeus threw down fire and broke the ship.
sentences.tgt: Zeus:o lança:v du:o feu:n et:o brisa:v le:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: All the men died but Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: Tous:o les:o hommes:n moururent:v sauf:o Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus held to the mast on the sea for nine days.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o resta:v accroché:a au:o mât:n sur:o la:o mer:n pendant:o neuf:o jours:n .:o

sentences.en: The sea took Odysseus to an island.
sentences.tgt: La:o mer:n porta:v Odysseus:o vers:o une:o île:n .:o

sentences.en: On the island lived Calypso.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o l':o île:n vivait:v Calypso:o .:o

sentences.en: Calypso saw Odysseus on her land.
sentences.tgt: Calypso:o vit:v Odysseus:o sur:o sa:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: She was good to him in her home by the sea.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o fut:v bonne:a envers:o lui:o dans:o sa:o maison:n près:o de:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Calypso: Stay here with me for all your days.
sentences.tgt: Calypso:o «:o Reste:v ici:a avec:o moi:o pour:o tous:o tes:o jours:n »:o .:o

sentences.en: Calypso: I will make you a god, and we will live here.
sentences.tgt: Calypso:o «:o Je:o vais:v te:o faire:v dieu:n ,:o et:o nous:o vivrons:v ici:a »:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: But my home is Ithaca, with my wife.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o «:o Mais:o ma:o maison:n est:v Ithaca:o ,:o avec:o ma:o femme:n »:o .:o

sentences.en: For long years Calypso kept him here.
sentences.tgt: Pendant:o de:o longues:a années:n ,:o Calypso:o le:o garda:v ici:a .:o

sentences.en: Each day Odysseus went to the sea.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o jour:n ,:o Odysseus:o allait:v à:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Then Athena went to Zeus.
sentences.tgt: Alors:o Athena:o alla:v vers:o Zeus:o .:o

sentences.en: Athena: Zeus, why must Odysseus stay here so long?
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o «:o Zeus:o ,:o pourquoi:o Odysseus:o doit:v -il:o rester:v ici:a si:a longtemps:a ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Athena: Send Hermes, and let this man go home.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o «:o Envoie:v Hermes:o ,:o et:o laisse:v cet:o homme:n rentrer:v chez:o lui:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Hermes came down to the island of Calypso.
sentences.tgt: Hermes:o descendit:v sur:o l':o île:n de:o Calypso:o .:o

sentences.en: Hermes: Zeus says you must let this man go home.
sentences.tgt: Hermes:o ::o «:o Zeus:o dit:v que:o tu:o dois:v laisser:v cet:o homme:n rentrer:v chez:o lui:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Calypso: I cannot say no to Zeus.
sentences.tgt: Calypso:o ::o «:o Je:o ne:o peux:v pas:o dire:v non:o à:o Zeus:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Calypso: Make a boat, and go home over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Calypso:o ::o «:o Construis:v un:o bateau:n ,:o et:o rentre:v chez:o toi:o sur:o la:o mer:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus cut down trees and made a boat.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o coupa:v des:o arbres:n et:o construisit:v un:o bateau:n .:o

sentences.en: He went away over the sea to his home.
sentences.tgt: Il:o partit:v sur:o la:o mer:n vers:o sa:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: But Poseidon saw Odysseus on the sea.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o Poseidon:o vit:v Odysseus:o sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Poseidon: This man will not get home so soon.
sentences.tgt: Poseidon:o ::o «:o Cet:o homme:n ne:o rentrera:v pas:o chez:o lui:o si:a tôt:a .:o »:o

sentences.en: He sent a great storm down on Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: Il:o envoya:v une:o grande:a tempête:n sur:o Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus was many days in the sea.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o passa:v de:o nombreux:a jours:n en:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: At last he came to a land.
sentences.tgt: Enfin:a il:o arriva:v dans:o une:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: This was the land of the Phaeacians.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v la:o terre:n des:o Phéaciens:o .:o

sentences.en: A woman came to Odysseus by the sea.
sentences.tgt: Une:o femme:n vint:v vers:o Odysseus:o au:o bord:n de:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Woman: Come and see my father the king.
sentences.tgt: Femme:o ::o «:o Viens:v voir:v mon:o père:n le:o roi:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The king of the Phaeacians was good to him.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n des:o Phéaciens:o fut:v bon:a envers:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: King: Come and eat with us, Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: Roi:o ::o «:o Viens:v manger:v avec:o nous:o ,:o Odysseus:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: King: Tell us your name and your land.
sentences.tgt: Roi:o ::o «:o Dis:v -nous:o ton:o nom:n et:o ta:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: I am Odysseus, who was at Troy.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Je:o suis:v Odysseus:o ,:o qui:o était:v à:o Troie:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus told the king of the Cyclops and Circe.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o parla:v au:o roi:n du:o Cyclope:o et:o de:o Circe:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: I have lost my ships and all my men.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o J':o ai:v perdu:v mes:o navires:n et:o tous:o mes:o hommes:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: King: We will give you a ship to take you home.
sentences.tgt: Roi:o ::o Nous:o vous:o donnerons:v un:o navire:n pour:o vous:o ramener:v chez:o vous:o .:o

sentences.en: The Phaeacians put gold on the ship for him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o Phéaciens:o mirent:v de:o l':o or:n sur:o le:o navire:n pour:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus slept as the ship went over the sea.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o dormit:v pendant:o que:o le:o navire:n traversait:v la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: At day the ship came to Ithaca.
sentences.tgt: Au:o matin:n ,:o le:o navire:n arriva:v à:o Ithaca:o .:o

sentences.en: The men put Odysseus down on his land.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n déposèrent:v Odysseus:o sur:o sa:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus woke on a land he did not know.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o se:o réveilla:v sur:o une:o terre:n qu':o il:o ne:o connaissait:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: Athena came to him as a man.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o vint:v à:o lui:o sous:o l':o apparence:n d':o un:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena: You are home now, in Ithaca.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o Vous:o êtes:v maintenant:a chez:o vous:o ,:o à:o Ithaca:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Then I must take care, for I have no men.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Alors:o je:o dois:v faire:v attention:n ,:o car:o je:o n':o ai:v pas:o d':o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena: The bad men are in your hall and want your wife.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o Les:o mauvais:a hommes:n sont:v dans:o votre:o salle:n et:o veulent:v votre:o femme:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena: I will make you an old man.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o ::o Je:o ferai:v de:o vous:o un:o vieil:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus became an old man.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o devint:v un:o vieil:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus went to the home of his pig man.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o alla:v à:o la:o maison:n de:o son:o porcher:n .:o

sentences.en: The pig man did not know his own king.
sentences.tgt: Le:o porcher:n ne:o reconnut:v pas:o son:o propre:a roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Pig Man: Come in, old man, and eat with me.
sentences.tgt: Porcher:o ::o «:o Entre:v ,:o vieil:a homme:n ,:o et:o mange:v avec:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Pig Man: My king Odysseus is lost on the sea.
sentences.tgt: Porcher:o ::o «:o Mon:o roi:n Odysseus:o est:v perdu:a sur:o la:o mer:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Your king is near, I tell you.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Votre:o roi:n est:v proche:a ,:o je:o vous:o le:o dis:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: That day Telemachus came home from the sea.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o jour-là:a ,:o Télémaque:o rentra:v chez:o lui:o depuis:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena made Odysseus the king again.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o rendit:v à:o Odysseus:o son:o apparence:n de:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Telemachus: Are you a god come to me?
sentences.tgt: Télémaque:o ::o «:o Êtes:v -vous:o un:o dieu:n venu:v vers:o moi:o ?:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: No, I am your father, home again.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Non:o ,:o je:o suis:v ton:o père:n ,:o de:o retour:n chez:o moi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Telemachus: Father, I have waited so long for you!
sentences.tgt: Télémaque:o ::o Père:n ,:o j':o ai:v attendu:v si:a longtemps:a pour:o vous:o !:o

sentences.en: They held each other and cried.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o se:o tinrent:v l':o un:o l':o autre:o et:o pleurèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Tell no one that the king is home.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Ne:o dites:v à:o personne:o que:o le:o roi:n est:v rentré:a .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: We will send the bad men from my hall.

sentences.en: Penelope came to the hall with the bad men.
sentences.tgt: Penelope:o vint:v dans:o la:o salle:n avec:o les:o mauvais:a hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: The man who wins my game will be king.
sentences.tgt: Penelope:o ::o L':o homme:n qui:o gagnera:v mon:o jeu:n sera:v roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: Here is the great bow of Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: Penelope:o ::o Voici:v le:o grand:a arc:n d':o Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: Bend it and shoot an arrow through twelve rings.
sentences.tgt: Penelope:o ::o Tendez:v -le:o et:o tirez:v une:o flèche:n à:o travers:o douze:o anneaux:n .:o

sentences.en: She set twelve rings up in a row.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o plaça:v douze:o anneaux:n en:o rang:n .:o

sentences.en: One by one the bad men came to bend the bow.
sentences.tgt: Un:o par:o un:o ,:o les:o mauvais:a hommes:n vinrent:v tendre:v l':o arc:n .:o

sentences.en: Not one of them was strong to bend it.
sentences.tgt: Pas:o un:o d':o eux:o n':o était:v assez:a fort:a pour:o le:o tendre:v .:o

sentences.en: The old man came up to the bow.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a homme:n s':o approcha:v de:o l':o arc:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Let me try the great bow.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o «:o Laissez:v -moi:o essayer:v le:o grand:a arc:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Suitor: Sit down, old man, this bow is not for you.
sentences.tgt: Prétendant:n ::o «:o Assieds:v -toi:o ,:o vieux:a homme:n ,:o cet:o arc:n n':o est:v pas:o pour:o toi:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: Telemachus: Give the man the bow, and let him try.
sentences.tgt: Télémaque:o ::o «:o Donnez:v à:o l':o homme:n l':o arc:n ,:o et:o laissez:v -le:o essayer:v .:o »:o

sentences.en: Odysseus took the bow and looked at it.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o prit:v l':o arc:n et:o le:o regarda:v .:o

sentences.en: He bent the bow and put the string on.
sentences.tgt: Il:o tendit:v l':o arc:n et:o mit:v la:o corde:n dessus:a .:o

sentences.en: The bad men grew still and looked on.
sentences.tgt: Les:o mauvais:a hommes:n restèrent:v immobiles:a et:o regardèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus put an arrow to the bow.

sentences.en: The arrow went through all twelve rings.

sentences.en: Odysseus: You said the king would never come home.

sentences.en: Odysseus: I am Odysseus, and I am here.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Je:o suis:v Odysseus:o ,:o et:o je:o suis:v ici:a .:o

sentences.en: The bad men got up and looked for the door.
sentences.tgt: Les:o mauvais:a hommes:n se:o levèrent:v et:o cherchèrent:v la:o porte:n .:o

sentences.en: Suitor: Put down the bow, Odysseus!

sentences.en: Suitor: We will pay for all we ate!
sentences.tgt: Prétendant:o ::o Nous:o paierons:v pour:o tout:o ce:o que:o nous:o avons:v mangé:v !:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: You ate my food and wanted my wife.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Vous:o avez:v mangé:v ma:o nourriture:n et:o vouliez:v ma:o femme:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: Now no one of you will get out.

sentences.en: Telemachus shut the doors of the hall.

sentences.en: Odysseus put his arrows into the bad men.

sentences.en: Telemachus and the pig man stood by the king.
sentences.tgt: Télémaque:o et:o le:o porcher:n se:o tinrent:v aux:o côtés:n du:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Suitor: The gods are with this man!

sentences.en: One by one the bad men fell.

sentences.en: Old Nurse: My king, are you home at last?
sentences.tgt: Vieille:a Nourrice:n ::o Mon:o roi:n ,:o êtes-vous:v chez:o vous:o enfin:a ?:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: I am home again, good nurse.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Je:o suis:v de:o retour:n chez:o moi:o ,:o bonne:a nourrice:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena stood by Odysseus.
sentences.tgt: Athena:o se:o tint:v aux:o côtés:n d':o Odysseus:o .:o

sentences.en: Athena: The bad men are dead, and your home is your own.

sentences.en: Odysseus: One thing is left for me now.

sentences.en: Odysseus: I must go up to my wife Penelope.

sentences.en: Penelope came to the hall.

sentences.en: She looked at the man who said he was her king.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o regarda:v l':o homme:n qui:o disait:v être:v son:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: They tell me the king has come home.

sentences.en: Penelope: But it has been so long, and I do not know you.

sentences.en: Odysseus: Look at me, Penelope, I am your king.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Regardez:v -moi:o ,:o Penelope:o ,:o je:o suis:v votre:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: I will not take a man I do not know.
sentences.tgt: Penelope:o ::o Je:o ne:o prendrai:v pas:o un:o homme:n que:o je:o ne:o connais:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: Penelope: Move our bed out of the room for this man.
sentences.tgt: Penelope:o ::o Sortez:v notre:o lit:n de:o la:o chambre:n pour:o cet:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: No man can move that bed, and you know why.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Aucun:o homme:n ne:o peut:v déplacer:v ce:o lit:n ,:o et:o vous:o savez:v pourquoi:o .:o

sentences.en: Odysseus: I made the bed from a tree in the ground.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o J':o ai:v fabriqué:v le:o lit:n à:o partir:v d':o un:o arbre:n dans:o le:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: Then Penelope knew this man was her own king.

sentences.en: She came to Odysseus and held him.

sentences.en: Penelope: Now I know you are my king.

sentences.en: Odysseus: And I know you are my own wife.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o ::o Et:o je:o sais:v que:o vous:o êtes:v ma:o propre:a femme:n .:o

sentences.en: The king and his wife told of their long years.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n et:o sa:o femme:n parlèrent:v de:o leurs:o longues:a années:n .:o

sentences.en: Athena kept back the day to give them more night.

sentences.en: Odysseus was home in Ithaca, and his long way was over.
sentences.tgt: Odysseus:o était:v chez:o lui:o à:o Ithaca:o ,:o et:o son:o long:a voyage:n était:v terminé:a .:o
